title: Lennar Q3 FY2026 results — the quarter ended 2026-08-31, released after the close 2026-09-16 into the FOMC decision's own session, call 2026-09-17 11:00 ET; the first homebuilder demand print this calendar has ever carried
source: IR: investors.lennar.com/press-releases/2026/09-02-2026-213038897, re-fetched direct by THIS event's owner lane 2026-09-16 (HTTP 200). The 2026-09-02 release, headlined verbatim "Lennar Corporation to Broadcast Its Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call on September 17, 2026", states that "the Company will release its third quarter 2026 earnings after the market closes on September 16, 2026" and that "the Company will host a conference call on September 17, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time". PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed on the costco-q4-fy2026-2026-09-24 precedent: the no-self-confirm limit binds the DISCOVERING lane (case-shiller-hpi-2026-09-29), not the owner, and this owner read the company primary itself. SEC: corroboration on a second, independent axis, and it contradicts the proposal's recorded blocker: data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000920760.json served THIS runner HTTP 200 (158,215 bytes) with the contactable UA the research fetch layer uses, where the discovering sweep recorded 403 — so the 403 was a header problem, not an egress block. EDGAR gives fiscalYearEnd 1130 (so Q3 ends 08-31) and an 8-K Item 2.02 record putting Q3 results on 2025-09-19 and 2024-09-19, mid-September every year, consistent with 09-16. Dated 2026-09-16 because that is when the information lands — the release, not the call; LEN's first tradeable reaction is the 2026-09-17 open. Checked 2026-09-16
notes: Canonical file written by this event's own initial research (2026-09-16) after reading the single proposal carrying this id in full — proposals/lennar-q3-fy2026-2026-09-16.from-case-shiller-hpi-2026-09-29.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. THREE changes from the proposal, each load-bearing. (1) STATUS estimate -> confirmed, per the source field above. (2) SYMBOLS [] -> ["LEN"]: market-events-types.ts defines the field as 'Symbols affected; empty = market-wide', and one builder's quarterly print is the opposite of market-wide. The proposal read 'symbols' as 'names this house tracks' and filed [] on the costco precedent's own first-pass reasoning — but that precedent's initial research had already corrected exactly this, for exactly this reason, and the practical cost of [] is that the deterministic screen has no price to diff, making every future pulse automatically material. (3) TITLE re-pointed at the collision that is the actual story: the release lands after the close on 2026-09-16, which is FOMC decision day (fomc-2026-09-16, high, confirmed), and housing-starts-2026-09-17 prints 08:30 ET the next morning — so the 2026-09-17 open reprices the Fed, the print and a housing-supply number at once, and is not a clean earnings read. IMPACT STAYS low, deliberately, and the reason is stronger than the proposal's: LEN is not a tracked name (earnings-calendar.ts covers NVDA/MRVL/AVGO/CRWV/MU), and a re-grep on 2026-09-16 confirms ZERO hits for LEN or any builder across docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md. Raising impact would buy more sessions for a name no playbook can act on — the churn #2946's horizon leash exists to cut. KIND STAYS sector, not earnings: market-events-types.ts reserves 'earnings' for entries derived from earnings-calendar.ts via earningsAsEvents and forbids hand-entry, and this lane may not edit that file. Research: docs/research/events/lennar-q3-fy2026-2026-09-16.md.
